主要内容: Credicorp Ltd announced that its subsidiaries El Pacífico Vida Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros (PV) and El Pacífico Peruano-Suiza Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros (PSG) completed a merger on August 1st, 2017. The merger was approved by the Superintendence of Banking, Insurance and AFP (SBS) via Resolution SBS N.° 2836-2017. As a result, PV acquired all rights and obligations of PSG, forming the new entity Pacífico Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros, abbreviated as Pacífico Seguros, with a capital stock of S/1,121,316,750.
